final: WITH o AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders od ON od.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = od.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM o) AS share FROM o) SELECT gender, cnt, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
